thought.text: Siap, fokus nomask. Saya buat file status yang jelas — mana terpakai, mana siap.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
live=json.load(open("nm_live.json"))
dead=["nmk_live_h6sUfOhMTBLD4GyNrx45jaeJDjhtMC6yCtfGegZC",
      "nmk_live_g1r1I3MMlZDJaclmlAFylupkQulRriMVhSaVx3xR"]
seen=set(); allk=[]
for f in ["nomask_live_keys.txt","nm2_api.txt","nm_api_keys.txt","nm_ready.txt"]:
    try:
        for l in open(f):
            m=re.search(r"(nmk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+)",l)
            if m and m.group(1) not in seen:
                seen.add(m.group(1)); allk.append((m.group(1), l.split("|")[0].strip()))
    except FileNotFoundError: pass
liveset={k for k,e in live}
with open("nomask_live_keys.txt","w") as f:
    f.write("# nomask — STATUS AUDIT 2026-11-17\n")
    f.write("# base url: https://api.nomask.ai/v1\n")
    f.write("# format: email | api_key | status\n")
    for k,e in allk:
        st="LIVE" if k in liveset else "HABIS"
        f.write(f"{e} | {k} | {st}\n")
print("LIVE:",len(liveset),"| HABIS:",len(allk)-len(liveset),"| total:",len(allk))
PY
head -4 nomask_live_keys.txt; echo "..."; grep -c "LIVE" nomask_live_keys.txt
